visualCharacteristics: Expandable FAQ list: full-width question rows separated by hairline rules, each with a +/- affordance that toggles a rich-text answer panel open. Light, comfortable, no images.
contentPattern: One row per Q&A: cell 1 is the question (the toggle), cell 2 is the answer content. All items start collapsed.
usage: FAQ pages — an expandable question/answer accordion.
